description: Raw queries retain the lower category after admission selects the higher option. Flags and action ranking do not change those answers.
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution lazy
%rule text $q(query)
%conditions matches($q,low) ∧ begins(from($q),low) ∧ ~l ⊆ tags($q,low)
%rule query high ≻ low
%tags ∅
%rule(leftmost-longest) high X Y
%tags ~h
%rule low X Y
%tags ~l
